display.purpose: Hero and section headlines, sentence case.

label.purpose: Nav, buttons, form labels, section eyebrows — always uppercase, wide-tracked.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Primary reveal/entrance easing across the site.

motion.name: ease-soft
motion.purpose: Button/state-transition easing, magnetic button spring feel.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid gold CTA with obsidian text and an extending hairline on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 32px; background: #c8a24c; color: #12100c; font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.28em; border: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e8cd83; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #c8a24c; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Line Button
components.description: Bordered secondary CTA that inverts to solid gold on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 32px; background: transparent; color: #c8a24c; border: 1px solid rgba(200,162,76,0.4); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.28em; transition: background 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), border-color 0.5s, color 0.5s; } .ds-btn-line:hover { border-color: #c8a24c; background: rgba(200,162,76,0.06); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #c8a24c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Contact-form field: flat panel background, hard edges, gold focus border.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.62rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: #b3ab97; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: rgba(26,23,18,0.5); border: 1px solid rgba(200,162,76,0.16); border-radius: 0; padding: 14px 16px; color: #eae4d6; font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif; transition: background 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #837a68; } .ds-input:focus { background: #1a1712; border-color: #c8a24c; outline: none; }

components.name: Nav
components.description: Fixed header: transparent at rest, blurred-obsidian on scroll, Cinzel wordmark and label-scale links.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 68px; padding: 0 24px; background: rgba(18,16,12,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(234,228,214,0.10); } .ds-nav-mark { font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: #eae4d6; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-mark:hover { color: #c8a24c; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 36px; } .ds-nav-links a { font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.66rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: #b3ab97; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: #c8a24c; }

components.name: Coin
components.description: Signature motif: transparent-PNG coin over a soft radial gold halo glow.
components.css: .ds-coin-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-coin-halo { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: 9999px; filter: blur(24px); background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 46%, rgba(232,205,131,0.28) 0%, rgba(200,162,76,0.12) 34%, transparent 64%); } .ds-coin { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }

narrative.overview: VIVERE's visual system is a Roman inscriptional aesthetic applied to a wellness-coaching brand: aged gold set against near-black obsidian, restrained to the point of austerity, with every ornament earning its place the way an engraving earns a coin's face. The system is built outward from two real physical objects (the gold wordmark logo and Samuel's three bronze challenge coins), not from a mood board; type, color, and motion all justify themselves by reference to metal, stone, and inscription rather than to contemporary web trends. It explicitly rejects generic fitness-influencer visual language (neon gradients, hype-typography, stock gym photography), clinical wellness-app aesthetics (teal, checklists, soft rounded cards), and the disposable brightness of a 2026 SaaS landing page.
keyCharacteristics: Locked dark theme: obsidian base, no light mode, no exceptions.
One accent color (gold) carrying the entire hierarchy; everything else is neutral.
Zero border-radius anywhere; every edge is a hard, cut edge.
Cinzel (display, inscriptional caps) against EB Garamond (body, humanist serif): a contrast pairing.
Motion is slow, physical, and expensive-feeling, never bouncy.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only saturated color in the system. If a new element needs emphasis, it earns gold or it stays neutral; it never gets a second hue.

rules.name: The No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: Text is never #fff; marble (#eae4d6) is the ceiling.

rules.name: The Small-Caps-Only Rule
rules.body: Cinzel at body-adjacent sizes is always uppercase with wide tracking (>=0.2em); never sentence-case running text below display size.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow appears anywhere in the system. Depth comes from background-color steps, never a drop shadow.

dos: Do keep gold as the only saturated color in any new component; neutrals do everything else.
Do set all interactive text (buttons, labels, nav) in Cinzel, uppercase, >=0.2em tracking.
Do keep every corner hard (0px radius) — buttons, inputs, panels, images.
Do use tonal steps (obsidian / obsidian-deep / panel / panel-2) for depth, never a box-shadow.
Do gate every new animation behind the existing prefers-reduced-motion handling.
Do reserve numbered sequences (I/II/III, 01-04) for things that are actually ordered.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue — success/error both resolve through gold + copy, not color-coding.
Don't add rounded corners, card shadows, or glassmorphic panels outside the two existing blurred-nav cases.

Don't reach for generic fitness-influencer or SaaS-marketing patterns: gradient text beyond the gold-sheen treatment, countdown urgency, stock gym photography, hero-metric stat blocks, pricing-card grids.
Don't use pure white (#fff) for text; marble (#eae4d6) is the ceiling.
Don't reuse gold for both focus and error states on the same field without another signal.
